t: A RISC-V single-board computer with 32 GB of memory and an AI chip.
steps: Order the 32 GB StarPro64 from the Pine64 Store for about 250 US dollars.
Buy a heatsink and a 12 V power supply of at least 3 A with a 5.5 by 2.1 mm barrel plug.
Download the RockOS Debian image linked from the Pine64 StarPro64 docs.
Write the image to a microSD card or an eMMC module.
Attach the heatsink, plug in a screen, keyboard, and network cable, and power on.
Log in and update the system from the command line.
Try the Pine64 AI SDK or Ollama pack to run a small language model.
